method: V12 compass set with a corrected GPT Image 2 horizontal left endpoint; the final right endpoint is a new direct high-quality GPT Image 2 output generated from only the fixed top-right and bottom-right endpoints, preserving their shared moderate three-quarter right yaw while interpolating only vertical pitch and gaze elevation; left.webp is used only for post-generation visual orientation QA; the accepted right-to-bottom-right midpoint remains unchanged

constraints.uniformResize: left generation source: 1280x1280 to 1254x1254; fixed right-diagonal Image API references: 1254x1254 to 1280x1280; accepted generated right source: 1280x1280 to 1254x1254 with no further scaling; accepted right-to-bottom-right midpoint: final uniform 1254x1254 to 1273x1273 alignment scale

inputs: prior V13 left endpoint: edit target for framing, scale, crop, shoulders, wardrobe, and horizontal pose correction
top-left.webp: fixed hair-only reference for crown height, width, side fullness, texture, and identity
center.webp: supporting identity, lighting, and wardrobe reference

regeneratedEndpoints.alignment: border-key normalized the 1280x1280 generated source to 1254x1254, retained that scale, and applied only a rigid 12-pixel-left and 5-pixel-down canvas translation; no rescaling, anisotropic warp, compositing, or content regeneration
inputs: top-right.webp: fixed accepted reference with equal authority for identity, camera distance, face/head scale, hair, body framing, clothing construction, lighting, placement, and crop
bottom-right.webp: fixed accepted reference with equal authority for identity, camera distance, face/head scale, hair, body framing, clothing construction, lighting, placement, and crop
regeneratedEndpoints.postGenerationQa: left.webp was visually compared only for opposite-direction yaw magnitude and was not sent to the Image API; candidate 1 was rejected for reading down-right and candidate 2 for reading too frontal, while candidate 3 was selected for level pitch, clear rightward yaw, and reference-matched framing

rebuiltTransition.alignment: retained the accepted GPT Image 2 midpoint content, uniformly resized the keyed 1254x1254 frame to 1273x1273, selected the 1254x1253 visible region beginning at x=14, y=0, and added one transparent top row; no anisotropic warp or content regeneration
inputs: historical corrected right endpoint source used when this accepted midpoint was generated: authoritative start pose, identity, scale, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
bottom-right.webp: authoritative end pose, scale, placement, hair, wardrobe, lighting, and framing
center.webp: supporting identity and wardrobe reference
